findings.title: Fan-Out Pattern Detected
findings.description: Root wallet 0x742d...bD18 distributed funds to 3 separate wallets within a 2-minute window, consistent with layering behavior used to obscure fund origin.

findings.title: DEX Swap Used for Token Obfuscation
findings.description: Intermediary wallet routed 15 ETH through Uniswap V2 Router, converting to USDT before forwarding. Token swaps through DEX routers can obscure the asset trail.

findings.title: Cross-Chain Bridge Transfer
findings.description: 37,500 USDC was sent through the Wormhole Bridge, enabling cross-chain movement that complicates tracing. Bridge transfers are a common technique to break the on-chain audit trail.

findings.title: Interaction with Flagged Address
findings.description: Wallet 0xC3D4...c1D2 sent 10.8 ETH ($31,400) to address 0xE5F6...e3F4 which is flagged as mixer-associated. Direct transfers to known risky addresses indicate potential money laundering.

findings.title: Circular Fund Flow Detected
findings.description: Funds flowed from the root wallet through intermediaries and returned via the flagged address 0xE5F6...e3F4, forming a circular pattern. Circular flows are a strong indicator of wash trading or layering.

findings.title: Mixer & Tumbler Obfuscation Point
findings.description: Node 0xE5F6...e3F4 is an identified mixer pool where on-chain traceability terminates. The transaction pattern exhibits deliberate entropy injection to sever the deterministic custody chain.

findings.title: Direct VASP Touchpoint (Binance Deposit)
findings.description: Collector wallet 0xD4E5...1d2E3 was identified as an attributed Binance exchange deposit address, providing a primary off-ramp identification endpoint.
